subject: Phase 100310: Zero-Config Default Database Path with Full Precedence
verdict_justification: Core database path resolution, CLI precedence chain, parent directory creation, help masking, and coverage thresholds were implemented and verified with green test suites. However, 48 binary LLVM profiling dumps (~18.5 MB) were staged in the git index, config system defaults hardcode SQLite backend even when DATABASE_URL infers Postgres, and one new Rust source file omitted the mandatory AGENTS.md responsibility header.

remediation.summary: All four findings and every plan_1hr item were resolved in the working tree. plan_unlimited items were assessed and deliberately deferred to their owning phases (no in-scope work was skipped). No test, threshold, scanner rule, or coverage gate was weakened.
remediation.final_gate: make coverage exit 0 — TOTAL lines 97.93% (36823 covered / 761 missed), functions 98.98% (3132 / 32 missed); 262 reported per-file rows, 0 below 90% on functions or lines. Baseline 97.89% lines / 98.92% functions; no regression.
remediation.scoped_verification: cargo test --locked -p clio-config: 137 passed / 0 failed (was 136; +1 new agreement test). cargo test --locked -p clio: all suites ok (binary 52, default_db_path_test 9, others 11/7/4/3). cargo clippy --locked -p clio-config -p clio --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
remediation.index_note: Per the remediation task rules the git index was never touched. The 48 staged .profraw blobs therefore remain in the staged snapshot; the working-tree deletion of those 48 files is visible in the unstaged `git diff` as `Bin 323152 -> 0 bytes`.

issues.title: 48 binary LLVM profiling dumps (.profraw) staged in Git index
issues.why_it_matters: Committing binary build/profiling artifacts bloats repository history, pollutes git status/diffs, and breaks repository hygiene standards.
issues.impact: 18.5 MB of unneeded binary machine-specific profile data is staged in git and would be committed to the repository.
issues.evidence: git diff --cached --name-only | grep '\.profraw$' lists 48 files in crates/clio-lib/ (e.g., crates/clio-lib/default_12130406370214325728_0_89478.profraw).
issues.proposed_fix: Unstage and delete all crates/clio-lib/*.profraw files. Add `*.profraw` to `.gitignore`. In `crates/clio-lib/tests/default_db_path_test.rs`, ensure subprocesses run with LLVM_PROFILE_FILE directed to a temp dir or filtered from workspace tracking.
issues.resolution: RESOLVED r1. Deleted all 60 .profraw files under crates/clio-lib (48 staged, 12 untracked); `find . -name '*.profraw' -not -path './target/*' | wc -l` = 0 after the final `make coverage`. Added `*.profraw` to .gitignore. Root cause fixed: default_db_path_test.rs::am() forwards the inherited LLVM_PROFILE_FILE to the child (it contains %p, so each child gets a unique file under the gitignored target/). I could not unstage: the remediation rules forbid touching the index, so the 48 blobs remain in the staged snapshot and their deletion appears in the unstaged `git diff` (Bin 323152 -> 0 bytes).

issues.title: Config system defaults hardcode backend: sqlite ignoring scheme inference
issues.why_it_matters: When DATABASE_URL=postgres://... is configured, the CLI infers Postgres, but effective config defaults backend to sqlite, causing StoreOpenOptions::from_effective to open SQLite rather than Postgres.
issues.impact: Downstream phases relying on StoreOpenOptions::from_effective (such as Phase 100330 am setup, guaranteed in §12) or inspecting config_get("backend") observe a backend/database mismatch where store.database_url points to Postgres while backend remains sqlite.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/config/merge.rs:35-43 calls resolve_database(get, None, None) which infers backend="postgres", but line 39 hardcodes `"backend": "sqlite"` in system_defaults.
issues.proposed_fix: Update `system_defaults` in `crates/clio-config/src/config/merge.rs` to set `"backend": resolved.backend` instead of `"backend": "sqlite"`, and ensure `Runtime::apply_process_env` sets `backend` when inferred from `DATABASE_URL`.
issues.resolution: RESOLVED r1. crates/clio-config/src/config/merge.rs:40 now reads `"backend": resolved.backend` from the same resolve_database call that already produced store.database_url, so the resolver stays the single source of truth. No duplicate inference was added to apply_process_env: the default already reflects DATABASE_URL through the injected lookup, and the env overlay's AM_BACKEND override still wins (asserted by `explicit_backend_env_still_wins_over_scheme_inference`). Tests added/updated: merge.rs::system_defaults_follow_the_resolver (backend sqlite with HOME only; backend postgres with DATABASE_URL) and config/db_agreement_tests.rs. Scoped proof: cargo test -p clio-config 137 passed / 0 failed.

issues.title: Missing standard AGENTS.md responsibility header in db_path_tests.rs
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md strictly mandates that every Rust source file, including test files, use the standard header with Responsibility, Owns, Does not own, and Boundary sections.
issues.impact: Inconsistent module documentation and breach of repository AGENTS.md style contract.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/db_path_tests.rs:1-4 contains only copyright and a single summary line without the required sections.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the standard AGENTS.md header structure with truthful Responsibility, Owns, Does not own, and Boundary doc comments to `crates/clio-config/src/db_path_tests.rs`.
issues.resolution: RESOLVED r1. crates/clio-config/src/db_path_tests.rs now opens with the full AGENTS.md header (# Responsibility; ## Owns: precedence tiers, inference, path shapes; ## Does not own: resolver implementation, config agreement, end-to-end CLI; ## Boundary). File is 207 lines, within the 450-line limit.
